request.style: English, storytelling country, warm baritone male vocal with light twang, acoustic guitar, pedal steel, fiddle, dobro, brushed drums, sorrowful but steady, 92 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Jacob had twelve sons, but one he loved the best
The son of his old age, set apart from all the rest
He made a richly ornamented robe for him to wear
And his brothers couldn't speak a kind word to him there

[Verse]
Out in the fields of Dothan they saw him coming on
Here comes that dreamer, let us kill him and be done
Reuben said don't shed his blood, just throw him in the pit
They stripped him of his robe and they dropped him down in it

[Chorus]
Twenty pieces of silver
For their brother, their own flesh
On a caravan to Egypt
With the balm and gum and myrrh
And the boy who wore the robe
Was a slave upon the road

[Verse]
They dipped the robe in goat's blood and they sent it home to say
We found this, is it your son's, and the old man turned away
It is my son's robe, he cried, a wild animal has torn him
And he would not be comforted, the father went on mourning

[Chorus]
Twenty pieces of silver
For their brother, their own flesh
On a caravan to Egypt
With the balm and gum and myrrh
And the boy who wore the robe
Was a slave upon the road

[Bridge]
Sold again in Egypt to Potiphar the guard
Far from his father's tent and the fields of home so far
But the brothers did not see it and the boy did not yet know
The LORD was with Joseph
Everywhere that he would go

[Outro]
Twenty pieces of silver
The LORD was with Joseph
